_readme: Hand-edited source for the generated site data. Every number arrives through a
fact-id placeholder; there is no path for a hand-typed one. The placeholder
syntax is in the README — it is not written literally here, because this file
is itself walked by the resolver.
SITES.<key>.stats[n].value   headline. Literal number = ERROR. Non-protocol
fact = ERROR. Tally = ERROR. Bound caveat = ERROR
(a tile has nowhere to put it).
SITES.<key>.tagline          headline. Same fact rules; a literal number here
is a WARN because taglines carry product names.
SITES.<key>.stats[n].label   WARN on a literal number.
SITES.<key>.shortDesc        prose. WARN on a literal number. Tallies are
allowed here, on the surface that generates them.
Run `node render/build-sites.mjs --check` to validate this file, and
the same command with `--source render/sites.source.withdrawn.json` to watch
the gate refuse a planted one.

zerotvm.name: zerotvm.com
zerotvm.tagline: Phi-3-mini in the browser on hand-written WGSL kernels, no compiler.
zerotvm.shortDesc: A browser LLM runtime whose kernels are written by hand rather than emitted by a compiler. The comparison it exists to make is a same-session paired run against WebLLM on identical weights. It carries {{fact:zerotvm.wgsl_files}} hand-written shaders, a count that lives here because this is the surface that generates it.

gpubench.name: gpubench.dev
gpubench.tagline: Crowd-sourced WebGPU compute benchmarks, one row per submitted run.
gpubench.shortDesc: A public benchmark table anyone can add a row to. It holds {{fact:gpubench.total_runs+caveat}} across all workloads. That count is a tally and a live one, so it appears here and nowhere else.

stats.label: queried directly, not via a cached endpoint
